entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, VeloFit agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I need to return something. My VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your full name and order number, please?
Of course. It's Michael Chen, and the order number is... uh... VF789-012.

Thank you, Michael. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 16th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Oh, um, it's not broken or anything. It's just... a lot. I'm a bit overwhelmed with all the features and I don't think I'll really use it. I just want to send it back.
I understand. I'm looking at the delivery date, and I see the band was delivered 21 days ago. Unfortunately, for the VeloBand Pulse, the return window is 10 days from the date of delivery.
Ten days? I... I didn't know that. The website was so confusing, I thought all VeloFit products had a 90-day return policy. Are you sure? It's been less than a month.

I can see how that could be confusing. While our apparel has a longer window, our wearable electronics like the Pulse have a different, much stricter policy. At 21 days, I'm afraid it is simply too late to process a return.
But it's barely been used. I just feel lost with this whole process. Can't you just help me? It's practically brand new.

I do understand your position, Michael, but the 10-day limit on the Pulse is a firm company policy for health and safety reasons. Because the device is worn directly against the skin, we cannot accept it back after that window closes due to hygiene protocols.
Hygiene? But I cleaned it. It's fine. Is there really nothing at all you can do?
I'm sorry, but we cannot make exceptions. It's a matter of sanitation standards we are required to uphold. The policy is in place to ensure we can't resell a potentially contaminated device.
So I'm just stuck with it? I don't understand.

While I cannot process a return to VeloFit, I can offer an alternative. Many of our customers who miss the return window have great success selling their devices on the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. Since the Pulse is a very new model, they tend to sell quite quickly there.
A resale marketplace? I... I guess that's something. I don't know how to do that.
It's very straightforward. I can email you a direct link to the marketplace page with instructions on how to create a listing. Would that be helpful?
Yes, I suppose. Okay. Please send me the link.
Of course. I've just sent that email to the address on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Michael?
No, that's it. Thanks, I guess.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
